pyg_landlord.text: The ceiling in the smoke room is covered in signatures. Climbers have been signing it since before the war, and the Everest team of 1953 signed it too.
Come in for tea, if the weather turns. In this valley the weather turns about every nine minutes.

pyg_instructor.text: I teach people to read a map in a cloud. You are meant to be calm. They are meant to be calm too. That is the difficult bit.
Plas y Brenin is the national mountain centre. Half the people you see on the hills in Britain learned something here.

pyg_photographer.text: Everyone stands here for the photograph. The lakes, the ridge, the reflection. It is a good photograph.
The Horseshoe in the morning is a postcard. By lunchtime it is a cloud. I take my pictures early and eat my sandwiches late.

champ_pyg_climber.text: Back again? Good. Hillary's lot trained on this very hill, you know. Nobody asked, but there it is.

intro: Right, rope up. Metaphorically. I'll not have you tangled in mine.
The mountain doesn't care how I feel about it, so I've brought a team that doesn't either.
champ_pyg_climber.win: Solid. If you'd been on the Everest team, you'd have carried the tea.
champ_pyg_climber.tired: You've had your week's climb. Come back on Monday and bring a flask.

then.text: Episode two will be a lot more dignified. I've promised the camera. Go and be brilliant somewhere.

else.text: {player}! Do you know who trained round here? The 1953 Everest team. I'm doing a series called Training Like Hillary. Episode one is me falling over.
I've been thinking about what the Enclosure did, up on the summit. Don't tell the algorithm. It likes me confident.
Fancy a quick battle? Entirely optional. It won't go on the channel. Probably.
Fair enough. Save it for when I'm less sweaty.
